description:
List all Ethora apps (tenants) owned by the currently logged-in user. Returns an array with `appId` (24-char hex), `displayName`, `domainName`, ownership and bot-status metadata. Credential fields (appSecret, tenantSecret, appToken, passwords) are redacted in the result; call `ethora-app-credentials-reveal { appId, confirm: true }` to reveal an app's appToken.
Auth: user-auth mode, active session (`ethora-user-login` first). Errors: 401 not logged in; empty list if the user owns no apps. Related: feed `appId` into `ethora-app-update` / `ethora-app-select`.
name: ethora-app-list
title: List Apps
